rationale: The bag was lost in the carrier's hands during the covered trip and reported to the airline, so section 5 (Baggage and Personal Effects) covers it, with the carrier's report and settlement letter plus proof of value on file. Under sections 5 and 10 the suit is capped at the Premium per-item limit of $300 (280 + 300 + 160 + 110 + 60 + 120 = $1,030), the airline's $400 payment for the same loss is deducted ($630), and the $50 Premium deductible comes off, giving $580, within the $1,500 benefit maximum.
